Tests EmbeddingModelType::Plugin variant deserialization in ChunkingConfig — config accepts the plugin variant shape; actual dispatch requires a host-language backend registered via register_embedding_backend at runtime

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput, ChunkingConfig, EmbeddingConfig, ExtractionConfig, ExtractInputKind

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), uri="https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf")
    config = ExtractionConfig(chunking=ChunkingConfig(embedding=EmbeddingConfig(max_embed_duration_secs=30, model={"name": "test-plugin-backend", "type": "plugin"}, normalize=True), max_characters=500, overlap=50))
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```
